name: Footer
purpose: Padded row at the foot of a sheet or dialog: the action row with Cancel and the accept button. A generic footer bar; the stats footer, bulk bar, trash strip and capture footer are separate widgets.

values.when: Single line, px-6, one bar height (B's default).
Padded row: py-5, px-6, gap-3. Sheet action row (Dialog footer, name sheets and confirm).
border-b edge-2. No catalogue use after the trash strip moved to Toolbar; kept for shape parity.
Drag the bar. Desktop only. Unverified for the capture footer (A records drag on the capture title row only).

platform: Same; the drag region is desktop only.
open: Dropped duplicates for this widget: B's pane stats footer (PaneFooter), bulk action bar (Toolbar), trash action strip (Toolbar) and capture bar footer row (Stack). The capture footer keeps px-3 py-2 (differs from the py-5 px-6 row), so it stays on Stack, per A. Bar height is one value after folding h-8 and h-9 (see PaneFooter).
